info.title: Live Studio API
info.description:
API for managing live streaming studios, including host accounts, schedules, attendance, performance tracking, and Shopee e-commerce integration.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require JWT Bearer token authentication. Obtain a token via `/api/auth/login`.

## Multi-Tenancy
This API supports multi-tenant isolation. Each user belongs to a tenant, and data is automatically filtered by tenant.
